title: Boila boilerplate entry
description: Frontmatter shape for a single boilerplate entry. Each .mdx file under apps/web/content/boilerplates/ must validate against this schema. The compiled registry.json is the public contract consumed by the npx boila CLI.

slug.description: URL slug. Must match the filename (sans .mdx) and the URL path /<slug>.

description.description: One-line pitch. Used on listing cards and the detail page lead.

repo.description: Public Git repository URL. Must be reachable for giget to clone.

branch.description: Optional branch to clone. Defaults to main.

subdir.description: Optional subdirectory inside the repo (for monorepo starters).

stack.description: Stack technology slugs (next, typescript, tailwind, prisma, ...).

useCases.description: Closed enum of supported use cases. Drives the catalog taxonomy.

features.description: Free-form feature tags (auth, payments, emails, ...) shown on the detail page.

bundledPlugins.description: Plugin slugs already wired into the base. Informational: shown on the detail page so users know what they get out of the box.

compatiblePlugins.description: Plugin slugs the CLI offers to add at scaffold time. Each slug must exist in plugins/.

maintained.description: true if the upstream repo is actively maintained (commit within ~6 months).

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Only permissive licenses are accepted.

preview.description: Optional preview image path under /public, ideally 1200x630.

addedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was added to the registry.

installCommand.description: Post-scaffold install command surfaced by the CLI.

envSetup.description: Required env var names. Shown on the detail page and in CLI post-scaffold output.
